summary: Iter62 — tested new /api/company-admin/crm-summary aggregation endpoint and CrmRetentionPanel integration in CompanyAdminDashboard. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases green covering role gates (resident=403, super_admin without override=400, no auth=401/403), shape, seeded counts (vip=2, late_payer=2 across linked compound 88ad3711), super-admin override path, capped lists with required fields (compound_name/unit_number/phone/email), and notes_total increment after POST /api/users/{id}/notes. Frontend: login as testcompany2 → /app/dashboard → CrmRetentionPanel renders with VIP=2 and Late=2 cards, drilldowns each show 2 user rows, and clicking a row opens UserTimelineModal with the existing CRM tag/note editor (late_payer chip pre-populated, notes textarea visible).

integration_issues.issue: When the modal opens for a resident clicked from CRM drilldown, a red toast appears: 'لا تملكين صلاحية الاطلاع على هذا المستخدم' and the console shows 2x 403 responses. The modal still renders user header, tags (late_payer chip) and notes editor correctly — but some inner endpoint (likely timeline/events fetch under /api/users/{id}/...) is denied for company_admin. This creates a confusing UX (success modal + permission-denied toast simultaneously). Tag/note CRUD inside modal was not blocked.

issues: Both VIP and Late cards have similar light-gradient pastel backgrounds — fine for light mode but the bold 4xl numbers are pure black (#111). On the red gradient the icon/number contrast is acceptable but consider adding a subtle border-bottom or explicit role label for screen readers.

action_items: Investigate the 403 fired by UserTimelineModal when opened from the CRM drilldown — identify which sub-endpoint denies company_admin (likely /api/users/{id}/timeline or /api/users/{id}/audit-log) and either grant company_admin access for users in their compounds or suppress the toast for that specific 403 since the CRM editor still works.

Optional: in CrmRetentionPanel, after closing the modal you bump refreshKey — confirm the parent in CompanyAdminDashboard actually does setRefreshKey(k+1) on modal close (not verified end-to-end this iteration since tag/note edits weren't performed).
critical_code_review_comments: company_admin.py:553 — `user_ids = [u['id'] async for u in db.users.find(...)]` materializes every user under all managed compounds into memory just to count notes. For companies with thousands of residents this is wasteful. Better: do a 2-stage aggregation or store compound_id on user_notes and count by compound_id directly.

CrmRetentionPanel.js:22 — toast.error is fired on any axios failure, including 401/network blips on first load (pre-AppVersionGuard reload). Consider suppressing the toast on the very first mount or only firing on res.status >= 500.

company_admin.py — `_resolve_company_id` raises 400 for super_admin without company_id; that is the right contract but the error message ('company_id query param مطلوب') is fine. No issue, just confirm frontend super-admin impersonation passes ?company_id.

CrmRetentionPanel only renders top-2 special tags (vip, late_payer) as cards; other tags appear as small chips. If product wants 'complainer' to also be a KPI card, a TAG_STYLE-driven loop would be cleaner than two hard-coded buttons.
Endpoint correctly excludes _id and uses serialize_datetime. Pipeline is efficient (single $unwind/$group). 👍

success_rate.frontend: 100% on requested flows; 1 secondary 403 toast inside modal noted

seed_data_creation: Test created and then deleted one note on user d6012878-... to verify notes_total++. No persistent test data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint /api/company-admin/crm-summary is fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_iter62_crm_summary.py (8 tests). Seeded fixtures: company ab8e7501... has compound 88ad3711... with 2 vip and 2 late_payer tagged users. Frontend integration verified via Playwright: CrmRetentionPanel data-testids in use are crm-retention-panel, crm-vip-card, crm-late-card, crm-drilldown-vip, crm-drilldown-late_payer, crm-user-{id}, crm-drilldown-close, crm-other-tags, crm-panel-loading. UserTimelineModal data-testid is user-timeline-modal. Note: login flow now goes through /select-account interstitial — must click the 'متابعة' button before reaching /app/dashboard. AppVersionGuard adds ~6s delay on first load. There is one cosmetic issue: opening the modal triggers a 403 toast from an inner endpoint — see action_items.
rca of the issue: 403 toast on modal open: not reproduced at API level in this iteration; the failing call did not block the visible CRM editor. Likely a timeline/events endpoint check that uses stricter ACL than user_crm. Suggested next step: open browser DevTools network tab while clicking a CRM-drilldown row and capture the exact URL returning 403 — then patch its permission check or hide toast for that path.
